'''Hak Soo Kim Anti-Revolution''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Hak Soo Kim]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Anti-Revolution
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Anti-Revolution Kim DS 1996 Designs.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Ok, here it is... couple notes... this is made especially against revolutions (which is very common in tourney decks) but does very well against other light decks too.

Again, this is a very expensive deck to make.. (once i get my *last* vader and a dark collaboration it'll be done!!@!@) Strategies are on the bottom... Enjoy. Hak :)

== Strategy ==

1. if you haven't noticed already, I have 8 alters but no senses. 8 to stop revolutions. Alters have higher destiny than senses. Light will usually play 4 alter/4sense in a tourney deck. If you are going to alter a revolution, they can only stop you by using senses. Thus 1/2 of their counterspells cannot be used to prevent you from altering. (alter cannot be used to stop alters) because of this you will almost always get your revs through. Since this is an offensive deck, you will be using a lot of interrupts based on destiny. light will try to sense your interrupts. because you have twice as many counters as they do, you will almost automatically win the alter/sense war. (back draw is you can't stop there interrupts except through boring conversation)

2. KILL OBI!!! If you can play circle... you have won the game. Without obim light is nothing. They will try to sense your circle but becuase you have twice as many countering ability, you'll usually get them through.

3. *important* don't try to alter if you are only holding one in your hand!!! (unless you are desperate) It will usually be sensed. Try to have at least 1 (good to have 2) as backup in the sense/alter war.

4. no takeels. Hopefully you will play your multiple battle destiny cards so takeels are ineffective anyway. besides takeels destiny number sucks.
